supersedes: v0.17.0 (abandoned broken line; archived on archive/0.17-broken-line)
strategy: reuse bundled official Pandoc engine with Qingye GUI
aiCollaboration: opt-in; loopback OpenAPI tool server off by default
interfaceStyles: MacOS (drawn traffic lights, rounded corners, glass; optional Windows 11 acrylic)
acceptance: Windows source: 117 unit tests passed, 1 POSIX-only test skipped; backend suite passed; 9 Electron smoke suites passed (including new pdf014 and 0.14 Markdown checks)
newFeatures: Office files (doc/docx, xls/xlsx/csv, ppt/pptx, ODF, RTF, WPS) open as PDF through bundled LibreOffice 26.2.6; installer + installed-directory ZIP only (no portable exe)
Pandoc: CJK-correct dialect, editor-native import, Word/ePub through Pandoc with themed reference.docx, diagrams, [toc], alerts, equation numbers and citations

Markdown: Typora-style inline marker reveal, CodeMirror 6 source mode, equation numbering with eqref, lazy rendering for large documents, crash-safe undo history, whole-line copy, smart input, Ctrl+wheel zoom

PDF: text markup bar (highlight/underline/strikeout/squiggly), shape annotations, deleting stored annotations, single-letter tools, redaction by content with Chinese presets, Bates numbering and stamp variables, odd/even pages, compression profiles, auto-crop, standard stamps
notBuilt: Android and macOS were not rebuilt for 0.14.0 (no mobile changes; macOS needs the GitHub Actions runners)
